assessment_type: Internal self-assessment — NOT a certified audit
disclaimer: This is a gap analysis for internal engineering planning. It is not, and does not claim to be, a SOC 2 report, an ISO 27001 certification, or a GDPR compliance certification. Those require an accredited third-party auditor. See STATUS.md.

controls.evidence: Cascading deletion verified across memory orchestrator, FAISS vector index, semantic cache, and SQLite document metadata store via DELETE /v1/documents/{doc_id} (204 No Content). Foreign tenants receive 404. Regression tested in tests/test_document_deletion.py.
controls.gap: None for single-node / SQLite store; multi-node distributed cache invalidation is out of scope for MVP.
controls.phase: Verified in Phase 4 & Phase 5, regression tested in Phase 11.

controls.control: Article 5(1)(e) / Article 25 — Data Minimization, Storage Limitation, Privacy by Design
controls.evidence: Submodular context packing minimizes LLM token consumption by filtering redundant chunks. PII redaction engine strips sensitive identifying elements before vector embedding and LLM prompt generation.
controls.gap: Automated document expiration / retention purge daemon across SQLite and disk storage.
controls.phase: PII redaction and context budgeting verified in aegis-docprep/tests/.

controls.evidence: src/compliance/redaction_engine.py and aegis-docprep/aegis_docprep/pii_redaction.py detect US SSN, credit cards (with Luhn mod10 validation), international and local phone numbers, emails, API tokens/keys, and person names with non-truncating surname preservation. Integrated into orchestrator via enable_redaction=True. Machine-verified in tests/test_compliance_redaction.py and aegis-docprep/tests/test_pii_redaction.py.
controls.gap: None for English alphanumeric PII entities.
controls.phase: Expanded in Phase 5, verified in Phase 11.

controls.evidence: SQLite metadata store isolated to application filesystem data directory. AES/Fernet encryption manager implemented in backend/security/encryption.py (verified in tests/test_security_framework.py).
controls.gap: Full-disk encryption or transparent database-level encryption (e.g. SQLCipher) in default container deployment.

controls.status: DEPENDS ON DEPLOYMENT — REVERSE PROXY TERMINATION
controls.evidence: Standard for FastAPI/uvicorn services: TLS termination is expected to happen at a reverse proxy/load balancer (e.g. Nginx, Traefik, AWS ALB). Application enforces secure header handling and HMAC SHA-256 webhook signatures.
controls.gap: Strict Transport Security (HSTS) headers must be injected by reverse proxy.
controls.phase: Documented in deploy/docker-compose.yml and production deployment specs.

controls.evidence: Fail-closed deny-by-default AuthGuardMiddleware (src/api/auth_guard.py) rejects unauthenticated requests with 401. Production RS256 JWT validation and API key lookup implemented in src/api/auth.py. Dev-token bypass strictly rejected outside AEGIS_ENVIRONMENT=development. Cross-tenant IDOR rejected with 404 across all CRUD routes. Machine-verified in tests/test_auth_guard.py, tests/test_production_auth.py, and tests/test_security_pentest_proof.py.
controls.phase: Hardened in Phase 0, Phase 4, and Phase 10.

controls.evidence: Tamper-evident structured audit logging (src/security/audit_logger.py) with SHA-256 cryptographic hash chaining (prev_hash). Immutable append-only log format detects retroactive alterations. Machine-verified in tests/test_persistence_and_audit.py.
controls.phase: Implemented in Phase 4, verified in Phase 11.

controls.evidence: Automated bandit static analysis and pip-audit dependency scanning reports maintained in production/security-audit/. Zero exploitable high-severity vulnerabilities in src/. Automated secret detection with .gitleaksignore allowlist tested in tests/test_repo_hygiene.py.
controls.gap: Continuous automated third-party SaaS scanner integration.

controls.evidence: Cryptographic RS256 asymmetric signatures for JWT verification, SHA-256 hash chaining for audit log integrity, SHA-256 HMAC signatures for webhook deliveries, and MD5 usage strictly restricted to non-security MinHash/LSH shingling (usedforsecurity=False).
